The device features a speaker grille on the top half, control buttons below the deck, and a carrying strap attached to the side. The cassette has a paper label with text and two visible spools.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the cassette label is illegible pseudo-text/gibberish, typical of AI generation failing to render coherent typography. The digital display on the player also shows nonsensical segments rather than clear numbers.
The row of control buttons below the cassette deck lacks distinct separation and mechanical logic; they appear fused together and unevenly aligned, lacking the crisp edges of real plastic buttons.
The perforation pattern on the speaker grille is irregular and non-uniform, with some holes merging or distorting, unlike the precise grid of a manufactured speaker cover.
The strap attachment point seems to float slightly or merge ambiguously with the casing corner, lacking a clear mechanical anchor point or screw.
